release_effect: NONE; completed graph and hashes unchanged
adoption_note: Adds a perturbation-spillover twin and a conditional path-specific rescue contract; no biological implementation, actual route membership or experiential target is admitted.

nodes.statement: Freeze one animal, limb, source, area-3a response, neighbour record, area-3a block, neighbour/sham operations, replay, downstream endpoint, common clock, analysis window, admissible spillover class and exclusion evidence before inference.
nodes.domain: One declared same-instance area-3a probe family.
nodes.scope: Probe semantics only; not complete organization, a unique owner or an experience-existence gate.
nodes.quantifier: One fixed same-animal, same-clock tuple at a time.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Different studies cannot jointly instantiate the tuple.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Fixes the items preserved in copy/rewiring.

nodes.statement: The target is actual contribution of the declared area-3a occurrence to the named downstream consumer endpoint, not response correlation, perturbation-associated endpoint change, observer reconstruction or report.
nodes.domain: The fixed A3U episode contract and declared alternative class.
nodes.scope: Actual-use target only; not familiar mineness, agency, ownership or basal experience.
nodes.quantifier: For each fixed source and endpoint context.
nodes.all_premises: Actual path membership and causal-path semantics.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: External endpoint construction prevents circularity but not common causes or direct spillover.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Separates the biological reader from a human observer of the trace.

nodes.statement: Within the declared binary class, complete S-by-G observation of local response R and independently acquired endpoint Y, plus null neighbour/sham controls, does not identify R-to-Y use when an area-3a-specific direct G-to-Y path is allowed.
nodes.domain: The two Boolean structural models in EXACT_RESULTS.json.
nodes.scope: Finite model-class nonidentification; no general impossibility or mathematical novelty claim.
nodes.quantifier: For every one of the four source-by-block cells in the declared class.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Independent exclusion evidence or a valid path-specific rescue can distinguish this pair.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Copy/rewiring replaces actual use with direct spillover while fixing all measured cells.

nodes.statement: A valid rescue keeps the area-3a block active, faithfully restores the relevant signal at the named downstream port, fixes source and timing, and independently excludes direct block/replay effects on the endpoint and alternative writers in the declared class.
nodes.domain: One fixed A3U episode and downstream port.
nodes.scope: Sufficient contract for the declared two-model discrimination, not arbitrary circuit identification.
nodes.quantifier: For each claimed rescue cell and its matched controls.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A replay that directly drives Y or a block that still suppresses Y is invalid.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Abacus/calculator tests live read versus copied answer.

nodes.statement: Given the episode and path-specific-rescue contracts, the cell S=G=Q=1 yields Y=1 in the declared use model and Y=0 in the declared direct-spill model.
nodes.domain: The same two Boolean models as A3U:C1.
nodes.scope: Conditional pairwise discrimination only; actual biological premises remain open.
nodes.quantifier: For the declared discriminating cell and fixed model equations.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A direct rescue-to-endpoint path destroys the interpretation.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: A faithful replay varies path restoration while fixing the block.

nodes.statement: Stop area-3a-mediated-use inference at the first failed gate among endpoint independence, source stability, selective block, region controls, exclusion witness, path-specific rescue and chronology; failure is INVALID_PROTOCOL, not no experience.
nodes.scope: Evidence triage only; no basal gate, no unique owner and no negative experience inference.
nodes.quantifier: For every evaluated package, all seven gates are jointly required for the declared rescue interpretation.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Passing the declared pairwise test does not exclude arbitrary mechanisms or identify H.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Bounds auxiliary instrumentation and forces return to the main line.

nodes.statement: If one independently admitted actual process and complete signature include a grounded selected-source-to-area-3a-to-downstream-use relation, C1 permits an experience-internal structural counterpart; H, agency, ownership, conceptual I and report require separate bridges.
nodes.domain: One independently admitted actual process and complete signature.
nodes.scope: Positive organization-inside-experience conditional, not a basal gate or exclusive owner.
nodes.quantifier: For each instance satisfying inherited C1 and all actual grounding premises.
nodes.all_premises: A:C1 plus actual bearer, interval, complete signature, route membership and separate target bridge.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Observer-only use, rewiring and false rescue block semantic naming.
nodes.thought_experiment_role: Returns endpoint work to experience–self without adding a homunculus.
